name: Extra Pagination
description: Adds a new set of pager items between the last visible pager link and the maximum pager number.
project_description: Extra Pagination is a very simple module that provides a new set of pager items between the last visible pager link and the maximum pager number. This is mainly done for SEO reasons to make us reach any page in 3-4 clicks maximum. It works with no configuration: on enable it overrides Drupal's core pager template and preprocess, inserting extra jump links so deep pages in a long listing stay reachable in a few clicks. Suggestions and feature requests are welcome.
